title: Nextiva Pricing in 2026: NEXT Core, Engage, Scale and Contact Center
summary: Nextiva lists NEXT Core at $15, Engage $25 and Scale $75 per user a month on an annual term, or $23, $50 and $75 monthly. See dialer plans, fees and terms.
body_markdown:
Nextiva publishes prices for its three small business plans. On an annual term, NEXT Core is $15, NEXT Engage is $25 and NEXT Scale is $75 per user a month. On the monthly view, they are $23, $50 and $75. The contact center plan Essential starts from $75 per agent a month. Professional and Premium, the two plans that list outbound dialing modes, are quoted by sales. The pricing page lists no free trial. The pages were read on November 18, 2026.


Trellus publishes this guide and sells a dialer that some teams would choose instead. Every Nextiva detail below comes from Nextiva's own pricing page, offer terms and legal terms, opened on November 18, 2026. The pricing page was read in a browser, because the monthly prices sit behind a switch. No price here comes from a review site. No Nextiva account was used and nothing was tested. Trellus also works with Nextiva: see the[Trellus integration for Nextiva](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations/nextiva) .


## Nextiva pricing at a glance


Nextiva's[pricing page](https://www.nextiva.com/nextiva-pricing) has two tabs. Small business shows the three NEXT plans with a switch between monthly and annual prices. Enterprise shows three contact center plans with no switch.


The annual prices quoted here are the small business band. A footnote says they apply to new customers with 1 to 100 employees who sign a paid agreement of 12 months or longer. The page publishes no other user-count band and no price for longer terms.


Nextiva plans in US dollars, from Nextiva's own pricing page, read on November 18, 2026. NEXT plans are per user a month and contact center plans are per agent a month. The page states no seat minimum. Plan Annual term Monthly Seat minimum Free trial What is included for calling


NEXT Core $15 $23 None stated None listed; demo Unlimited voice and video calling, call recording, 100 business text messages per user, call routing, 50 AI transcriptions and 50 AI summarizations. Toll-free numbers and virtual fax are add-ons. No dialer listed


NEXT Engage $25 $50 None stated None listed; demo Core plus live chat and a chatbot, 500 text messages per user, one toll-free number, 2,000 toll-free inbound minutes, virtual fax and single sign-on. No dialer listed


NEXT Scale $75 $75 None stated None listed; demo Engage plus unlimited text messages, three toll-free numbers, 10,000 toll-free inbound minutes, supervisor monitoring and unlimited AI transcriptions. No dialer listed

Contact center Professional Not published; contact sales Not published Not published None listed; demo Essential plus email and SMS, list and campaign management, progressive, predictive and Quarterback dialing modes, voicemail drop and supervisor dashboards

Every plan button on the page reads Get a Demo. A line under the plans says all plans include 24/7 support, that no credit card is required for a demo, and that customers can cancel anytime. The cancellation terms below add conditions to that.


## What changes the real cost of Nextiva


The seat price is public for the NEXT plans. The bill also depends on the term, add-ons, AI usage, fees and any offer in force.


### Term length


The page says annual pricing saves 35% on NEXT Core and 50% on NEXT Engage. NEXT Scale shows $75 on both views. The lower prices need a term of at least 12 months.


Nextiva's[legal terms](https://www.nextiva.com/legal.html) say service renews automatically for a term of the same length unless the customer cancels at least 30 days before the term ends. The Cancellation Policy on the same page says a customer on a minimum commitment contract owes all charges for the whole of the current term, plus any disconnect fee.


On a month-to-month agreement, the policy says a cancellation takes effect on the last day of the first billing period that is at least 30 days after notice.


### The money back guarantee


The Cancellation Policy describes a 30-day money back guarantee for new customers. It has conditions. It does not apply to minimum commitment contracts, to customers who used more than 500 minutes on an unlimited plan, or to customers who used contact center services. So it does not cover the annual-term prices above.


### Black Friday and switching offers


On November 18, 2026, a banner on the pricing page advertised three months free for Black Friday. The[offer terms](https://www.nextiva.com/x/next-xbert-3-months-free-terms) say it is valid through November 27, 2026. The per-user prices in the table are Nextiva's regular prices. The offer does not change them.


The terms limit the offer to new customers who sign for 12 paid months or longer for NEXT service with the AI Employee add-on. Base license fees are waived for up to three months, starting with the second monthly bill. The free months are added to the contract, so 12 paid months become a 15-month term. The first month, one-time charges, add-ons, excess usage, taxes and fees are still charged. The[offer page](https://www.nextiva.com/x/black-friday-2026) has the form to claim it.


A separate[Switch and Save offer](https://www.nextiva.com/x/switch-save-offer) advertises up to 12 months free for businesses with up to 200 employees that move from another provider. It requires proof of the current contract and a NEXT Core or NEXT Engage subscription of at least 12 months.


### XBert AI usage


Each NEXT plan card lists XBert AI at $1.50 per conversation. The plans also include AI Answer Assist conversations: 50 on Core, 200 on Engage and unlimited on Scale. The stand-alone XBert AI Employee is $99 a month, with packages starting at 100 conversations a month.


### Texting, toll-free and fax


Text messages are capped at 100 per user on Core and 500 on Engage, and are unlimited on Scale. On Core, a toll-free number, toll-free inbound minutes and virtual fax are add-ons. The page does not publish add-on prices. Its footnote says add-ons are billed separately and may involve setup, licensing or usage fees.


Prices for extra phone numbers and international calling rates are not published on the pricing page. Desk phones work with every plan and are bought separately. A Professional Services Package is an add-on on all three NEXT plans.


### Fees and price changes


The legal terms describe a Regulatory Recovery Fee and an e911 Fee, charged monthly, that may apply to every phone number on the account. They say these are not government taxes. The amounts are not published there, so ask for an itemised quote.


The terms also say fees may change, with or without notice. Base service pricing for contracted quantities does not change during the initial term of a minimum commitment contract.


## Who Nextiva fits and who it does not


Nextiva says every NEXT plan includes business phone and team messaging, with AI added when a team is ready. It labels Core for small teams, Engage for growing teams and Scale for sales and service teams. That fits a business that wants calling, video, texting, shared inboxes and ticketing on one bill, and is willing to sign for a year to get the lower price.


The contact center plans fit a larger team that needs routing, campaigns and predictive dialing, and is ready to buy through sales.


Nextiva is a weaker fit for a team that wants to try a product or buy it online first. The page lists no free trial, and every plan leads to a demo request. It is also a weaker fit for month-to-month buyers, since Core rises to $23 and Engage to $50.


It is a weaker fit for a small outbound team that wants a dialer at a public price. No NEXT plan lists a dialer. Dialing modes, campaign management and voicemail drop start at contact center Professional, which is quoted. Nextiva's Acceptable Use Policy, on the legal terms page, bars auto-dialing except where Nextiva expressly authorizes it with certain contact center services.

The[Trellus power dialer](https://www.trellus.ai/power-dialer) plan, Power, is $99.99 per seat per month. The[Trellus parallel dialer](https://www.trellus.ai/parallel-dialer) plan, Power + Parallel, is $149.99 and calls up to five numbers at once. Both are bought online with no seat minimum. There is no free plan or free trial, and the Business plan is custom. The plan details are on[Trellus pricing](https://www.trellus.ai/pricing) .


NEXT Core and NEXT Engage cost less per seat than either Trellus plan and include a phone system and texting. Trellus is a dialer for outbound lists, sells single seats online, and texting is not listed in its plans.


Trellus also has a[Nextiva integration](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations/nextiva) that power dials an uploaded list one contact at a time through the Nextiva browser softphone. Nextiva's policy restricts auto-dialing, so check with Nextiva before dialing lists on a NEXT plan.

## Frequently asked questions


### How much does Nextiva cost per user?


Nextiva's pricing page lists NEXT Core at $15, NEXT Engage at $25 and NEXT Scale at $75 per user a month on an annual term. On the monthly view they are $23, $50 and $75. The annual prices apply to new customers with 1 to 100 employees who sign for 12 months or longer.


### Does Nextiva have a free trial?


The pricing page lists none. Every plan button reads Get a Demo. Nextiva's Cancellation Policy describes a 30-day money back guarantee, but it excludes minimum commitment contracts, which the annual prices require.


### Which Nextiva plan includes a dialer?


The contact center plans Professional and Premium. The pricing page lists progressive, predictive and Quarterback dialing modes, campaign management and voicemail drop on both. Their prices are not published. Contact center Essential and the three NEXT plans list no dialer.


### What is Nextiva's Black Friday offer in 2026?


Three months free, valid through November 27, 2026. The terms limit it to new customers who sign for 12 paid months or longer for NEXT service with the AI Employee add-on. The free months extend the contract, and add-ons, usage, taxes and fees are still charged.


### What costs extra on Nextiva?


XBert AI is $1.50 per conversation. Toll-free numbers, toll-free minutes and virtual fax are add-ons on NEXT Core, at prices the page does not publish. Desk phones are bought separately. The legal terms add a monthly Regulatory Recovery Fee and e911 Fee, and taxes apply.
